metadata.title: CCM genetic landscape: aggregate statistical reproducibility
metadata.description: Aggregate-count statistical reproduction accompanying The genetic landscape of familial and sporadic cerebral cavernous malformations. Recomputes Wilson intervals, detection and sensitivity summaries, Fisher exact tests, Mantel-Haenszel estimates, CMH tests and exact conditional stratified tests from frozen aggregate counts. Does not redo literature screening, individual-case extraction, record-level filtering, genomic plotting, transcriptomic modeling or BioRender artwork. Contains no participant-level records, article PDFs, third-party gene-set memberships or BioRender assets.
metadata.notes: Private-repository initial-deposit package prepared 2026-10-21 for https://github.com/galenweng92-jpg/CCM-genetic-landscape . This is not a public release and no archival DOI is assigned. Code and literature-derived aggregate-data rights are documented separately in RIGHTS_AND_PROVENANCE.md. Licensing and publication metadata require author confirmation before deposition.
